<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md before submitting.
Keep credentials, personal/tenant data, and private repository content out of this PR.
Report undisclosed vulnerabilities privately through SECURITY.md.
-->

## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include a before/after example
when it helps explain the change.

## Related issues and scope

Link the GitHub issue(s) and identify the acceptance criteria satisfied.
Use `Closes #...` only when this PR completes the issue; use `Refs #...` for
partial work. Link dependencies or follow-up work when applicable.

## Validation

List the relevant checks, commands, and results. Explain checks that were not
run and why. Required CI for the current PR head must pass before merge.

## UI and documentation impact

Describe UI changes and include screenshots when useful, link tracked UI
follow-up, or explain why no application UI adaptation is required. Identify
any documentation or architecture-contract updates.

## Risks and compatibility

Describe applicable security/data boundaries, migration or deployment effects,
and rollback or mitigation. For model usage, mutable definitions, external
actions, workers, or extensions, include the relevant evidence required by
AGENTS.md. Write `Not applicable` when appropriate.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change follows CONTRIBUTING.md and the applicable AGENTS.md guidance.
- [ ] Validation evidence and UI/documentation impact are recorded above.
- [ ] Every commit includes my `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`) under the Developer Certificate of Origin.
